skill_name: Describe the differences between an independent contractor and an employee.
workflow: The primary difference between an independent contractor and an employee is the amount of control that a company has over the individual. Employees are under the control of the company—the company sets the hours to be worked and the tasks to be done. Employees are also entitled to benefit packages, such as health insurance, workers’ compensation, and paid vacations.
